text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What!? You planted a 'timed water balloon 
bomb' in the hall!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kekeke, I'll tell ya the unlock code. Only 
if Mame-chin does a handstand and gives me 
her paw, though!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I must refuse, sir! Isn't talk of a bomb 
just your usual nonsense anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Too bad! Take a look at this footage! See 
that timer ticking away?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(What's reflected at the bottom is... a 
vending machine!\n—Alright, I've 
pinpointed the location.\nAt this rate, 
I'll extract the unlock code too...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the bomb itself might be a fake, sir. 
Can you prove that it is real, sir?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's the latest version I 
bought online! Look, right here! It's the 
exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What if the disarm code they teach 
us is a fake? As long as there's doubt, I 
cannot accept these terms!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, seriously?! It's voice-activated! 
One good dog bark'll unlock it in a snap!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what a blunder! If I shout loudly 
enough, my voice will reach the bomb!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pff... Buwah! Ha, fell for it! Mame-chin 
is such an innocent doggy~♪
